description: Regional Energy Strategic Planner (RESP) Regions is a dataset listed in Northern Powergrid open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by Northern Powergrid. This shapefile contains the regions covered by the various Regional Energy Strategic Planner (RESP) regions and has been provided to Northern Powergrid by the National Energy System Operator (NESO) Related datasets and pages NESO RESP Announcement - If you wish to find out more about the RESP, please click here to view NESOs news item ... Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Network. Its keywords are Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-07-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Northern Powergrid Open Data Licence v1.0 (https://northernpowergrid.opendatasoft.com/p/opendatalicence/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-npg-open-data-portal.
